name: Mushkpuri Top & Khanpur Dam
short: A day trip for mountain views at Mushkpuri Top and time around Khanpur Dam, with the route confirmed before departure.
overview: A day out in the hills, with mountain scenery at Mushkpuri Top and time around Khanpur Dam. We'll confirm the exact route with you before departure.

itinerary.title: Mushkpuri Top and Khanpur Dam Day Trip
itinerary.description: We meet at the pickup point and head out, with rest and refreshment stops on the way. The plan is to visit Khanpur Dam and/or Mushkpuri Top, and we'll confirm before departure whether both fit into one day and in which order. Local jeep rides, paid activities, entry charges and personal shopping are not included. The group meets up again at an agreed time for the drive back to the drop-off point.

name: Shogran & Siri Paye
short: Mountain views in Shogran and the open meadows of Siri Paye.
overview: Two days in the Kaghan region, with a night in Shogran to enjoy the mountain views and a morning up at the meadows of Siri Paye.

itinerary.title: Drive to Shogran
itinerary.description: We set off from the pickup point and drive through the Kaghan region, with rest stops along the way. Once we reach Shogran, check in and settle in, then head out to the nearby meadows and viewpoints if there's time after arrival. Dinner follows, with a bonfire if local conditions allow, and we spend the night in Shogran.

itinerary.title: Siri Paye Meadows and Return
itinerary.description: After breakfast, we head up to Siri Paye Meadows and its viewpoints, as long as the road and weather allow. The 4x4 jeep up to Siri Paye is not included, so budget for it separately if you go. Once you've had time for photos, we return to the meeting point, check out and start the drive home with rest stops along the way.

name: Naran Valley & Babusar Top
short: Naran Valley and the views around Babusar Top, when the pass is open for the season.
overview: Three days in Naran Valley, with a full day out towards Lulusar Lake and Babusar Top. Babusar depends on seasonal road access.

itinerary.title: Drive to Naran via Kaghan Valley
itinerary.description: We leave the pickup point and drive up to Naran, stopping at rest areas and scenic spots when time and traffic allow. After checking in, you'll have free time to freshen up and wander around Naran Bazaar or down by the Kunhar River. Dinner and overnight in Naran.

itinerary.title: Saif-ul-Malook, Lulusar Lake and Babusar Top
itinerary.description: The day starts with breakfast and a check on road and weather conditions. We visit viewpoints around Naran, then continue to Lulusar Lake and Babusar Top if the pass is officially open. The jeep to Lake Saif-ul-Malook, any other 4x4 transfer, boating, entry tickets and optional activities are paid separately. There's time for stops and photos before we head back to Naran for dinner and the night.

itinerary.title: Checkout and Drive Home
itinerary.description: Pack up and check out after breakfast. If time, traffic and the route allow, we'll make a few short stops at viewpoints on the way back. There are rest and refreshment breaks before we reach the drop-off point, and arrival time depends on road, weather and traffic.

name: Neelum Valley & Arang Kel
short: Rivers, green valleys and the hillside village of Arang Kel in Azad Kashmir.
overview: Three days along the Neelum River in Azad Kashmir, with green valleys, river views and a walk up to the hillside village of Arang Kel.

itinerary.title: Along Neelum Valley to Sharda or Keran
itinerary.description: We leave the pickup point and head into Azad Kashmir, clearing any checkpoints or entry formalities on the way. The road follows the Neelum River, with rest and photo stops, plus viewpoints or waterfalls if timing and road conditions allow. We check in at the hotel, have dinner and spend the night in Sharda or Keran.

itinerary.title: Kel and Arang Kel Village
itinerary.description: After breakfast we continue to Kel, the starting point for Arang Kel. The walk up is uphill, so we take it at the group's pace, with rest stops and time at the village viewpoints. Local jeep transfers, chairlift or cable-car fares, porters and optional activities are not included and are paid directly. We return to the hotel for dinner and the night.

itinerary.title: Valley Stops and Return
itinerary.description: Check out after breakfast and start the drive back. Where the schedule allows, we stop at viewpoints or by the river, with rest breaks along the way before drop-offs. Final timings depend on traffic, checkpoints and road conditions.

name: Swat Valley & Mahodand Lake
short: Swat's mountain scenery and a day out to Mahodand Lake, depending on road and weather conditions.

itinerary.title: Drive to Swat and Kalam
itinerary.description: We set off from the pickup point and drive through Swat up to Kalam, with rest stops and viewpoints along the way. After checking in, settle in or take a walk around the bazaar and river area if there's still daylight. Dinner and overnight in Kalam.

itinerary.title: Ushu Forest and Mahodand Lake
itinerary.description: After breakfast we head into upper Kalam to see Ushu Forest and Mahodand Lake, as far as access and weather allow. itinerary.title: Checkout and Return
itinerary.description: Once everyone has had breakfast and checked out, we start the drive home. We take rest stops and, if timing allows, a few quick roadside viewpoints. Arrival at the drop-off point depends on road and traffic conditions.

name: Kumrat Valley & Katora Lake
short: Kumrat Valley with a trek to Katora Lake, depending on trail conditions.
overview: Four days in Kumrat Valley, including a trek via Jahaz Banda to Katora Lake. We confirm the trekking plan before departure, and it depends on trail and weather conditions.

itinerary.title: Drive to Kumrat Valley
itinerary.description: We set off from the pickup point and drive via Dir and Thal to Kumrat Valley, stopping for meals or refreshments along the way. After we check in at our hotel, guesthouse or campsite, the guide runs through the next day's route with the group. Dinner and overnight in Kumrat.

itinerary.title: Kumrat to Jahaz Banda Meadows
itinerary.description: After breakfast we transfer to the Jahaz Banda trailhead; local jeep or 4x4 transfers to remote trailheads are not included. The trek goes at a pace that suits the group, with rest stops and viewpoints along the way. It ends at our overnight stay or campsite, where dinner is served.

itinerary.title: Katora Lake Trek
itinerary.description: An early start with breakfast or the agreed trek meal, then we follow the guide's route up to Katora Lake. We allow plenty of time for the climb, weather checks, rest breaks and photos. The trek depends on weather and fitness, and we won't continue if the guide decides conditions are unsafe. Afterwards we head back down the trail to our overnight stop, and optional porters and personal expenses are not included.

itinerary.title: Descent and Drive Home
itinerary.description: Pack up after breakfast and head down or transfer back to the meeting point, depending on where we spent the night. From there, the group vehicle takes us home through Thal and Dir with rest stops on the way. Arrival time depends on trail, road and weather conditions.

short: Hunza's mountain views, historic villages and best-known Karakoram viewpoints.

itinerary.title: Heading North to Gilgit-Baltistan
itinerary.description: We leave the pickup point and start the drive north on whichever route is open for the season, with rest and refreshment stops along the way. Where we stop for the night depends on your departure city, road conditions and whether the Babusar route is open.

itinerary.title: Karakoram Highway to Hunza
itinerary.description: After breakfast, we continue north and stop at viewpoints along the way, including around Gilgit if timing allows. Once we reach Hunza and check in, the rest of the day is free to explore Karimabad or the nearby bazaar. Dinner and overnight in Hunza.

itinerary.title: Karimabad, Baltit Fort and Altit
itinerary.description: A day in and around Karimabad, with its bazaar and viewpoints. Baltit Fort, Altit Fort and other paid sites may be on the plan, but entry tickets and optional activities are not included. You'll have free time for photos and shopping before dinner and the night at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Attabad Lake, Gulmit and Passu
itinerary.description: Today we drive up the Karakoram Highway to Attabad Lake and Upper Hunza, stopping for views along the way. itinerary.title: Checkout and Return

name: Fairy Meadows & Nanga Parbat
short: Alpine meadows and close views of Nanga Parbat. We confirm local jeep transfers and trekking arrangements with you before the trip.
overview: Five days to Fairy Meadows, with a jeep ride to Tato, a trek up to the meadows and a full day near Nanga Parbat. Local jeep transfers and trekking arrangements are confirmed with you before the trip.

itinerary.title: Road Journey to Raikot Bridge
itinerary.description: We set off from the pickup point and drive north towards Raikot Bridge, with rest and refreshment stops along the way. Depending on your departure city and the roads, we spend the night at a planned stop on the way or near the bridge.

itinerary.title: Jeep to Tato and Trek to Fairy Meadows
itinerary.description: After breakfast we head to the trailhead. The 4x4 jeep from Raikot Bridge to Tato is not included and is paid locally. From Tato, we trek uphill to Fairy Meadows with the guide at a steady group pace, with rest stops. We check in at our hut, guesthouse or camp and enjoy the evening if the weather allows.

itinerary.title: Fairy Meadows and Nanga Parbat Views
itinerary.description: A full day at Fairy Meadows, exploring the viewpoints with the guide. An optional walk towards Beyal Camp or Nanga Parbat Base Camp depends on fitness, weather, trail conditions and the final plan. Optional activities, pony or porter hire, equipment hire and personal purchases are not included. We spend another night at the meadows.

itinerary.title: Descend to Tato and Drive On
itinerary.description: Pack up after breakfast and walk back down from Fairy Meadows to Tato at a safe, steady pace, resting as needed. From Tato, the local jeep takes us to Raikot Bridge, and this fare is not included. There we rejoin our transport and drive on to the night's stop.

itinerary.title: Return Journey
itinerary.description: The last day is the drive home. After breakfast and checkout, we head back with rest stops along the way, and arrival time depends on your departure city, the roads and traffic.

short: Skardu's mountain scenery and the wide Deosai Plains, when the park is open for the season.

itinerary.title: On to Skardu
itinerary.description: After breakfast, we continue to Skardu, stopping at viewpoints when time allows. Once you've checked in, you can explore the nearby market or a local viewpoint if there's time before dinner.

itinerary.title: Deosai Plains and Sheosar Lake

itinerary.title: Valley Excursion and Packing Up
itinerary.description: The last full day covers the remaining planned stops, such as a nearby valley, fort or viewpoint. Entry tickets and optional experiences are extra. Back at the hotel, collect your luggage and get ready for the return leg.

itinerary.title: Return Journey
itinerary.description: We check out after breakfast and drive home, stopping for refreshments and rest at planned spots. Arrival time depends on the road, the weather and your drop-off city.

itinerary.description: We start with breakfast and carry on exploring the valley and lake area, following your guide's plan for the day.
